update goods
goods_name = #{goodsName},
goods_code = #{goodsCode},
unit = #{unit},
remark = #{remark},
update_time = now(), version = version + 1
where goods_id = #{goodsId} and version = #{version} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select:
select goods_id, goods_name, goods_code, unit, remark, update_time from goods
is_delete=0
and goods_name like concat('%', #{goodsName}, '%')
and create_time=concat('%',#{createTime},'%')
